properties.name: The typed edge tools name draw_edges' real argument (`edges`), read from its schema, and a check reads every served description for argument names its tool does not take
properties.rationale: Root cause (fact:draw-edges-is-named-with-items-in-32-tool-descriptions-though-it-takes-edges-a-recurrence-2026-10-26): argument names written in served text were checked against no schema, the class the 2026-09-28 finding named and whose pinning test was never written. Fixing only the word would leave the class open, so the generated sentence now takes its argument name from the request type, and a class check covers hand-written descriptions too. Before/after, measured: on main fb9286c46 both new tests fail, each naming the 32 helpers whose description names `draw_edges` with `items`; with the fix they pass. The general check found no other wrong argument name on the 199-tool surface. Its scope is stated, not hidden: a census of a looser reading (any tool name followed by a backticked word) named 24 pairs, 16 of them reply fields, gap kinds or values, so only three shapes whose grammar says "argument" are read ("`tool` with `a`", "`tool`'s `a` argument", a JSON example after a tool's name). Not read: "pass `x`" (a value in 3 of 25 uses), skills, and names inside an argument beyond their root. A first version cached the name in a static; no_per_design_process_globals refused it, and the static was dropped because rmcp already caches the schema. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: bulk_edges.rs name_the_bulk_route now appends "MANY AT ONCE: `draw_edges` with `edges`: [{"tool": "<name>", "arguments": {…}}], same checks, all or nothing." to the 32 typed edge helpers' listed descriptions, in place of "`draw_edges`, items {…}". The argument's name is no longer typed by hand: draw_edges_list_argument reads it from DrawEdgesReq's schema (rmcp's schema_for_type, the generator #[tool] uses), as the property whose items are DrawEdgeItems. Still applied at list time, so find_tools ranks the router's descriptions unchanged (tool_confusability.py's strip pattern updated; replica agrees 229/229 at top 1). New checks: a_bulk_edge_write_keeps_each_helpers_checks.rs::the_bulk_sentence_names_only_what_draw_edges_takes sends the sentence's call as written (check_only) and requires it to be taken; a_served_description_names_only_arguments_its_tool_takes.rs reads every served description and schema description for arguments named in three shapes and checks each against the tool's served input schema. 32 toolsnaps regenerated.
